title: Research: certify sharp QQ16 borrowed-field reuse stability
body:
## Summary

Add `research/qq16-borrowed-reuse-stability/`, a source-bound restoration lemma and independent checker for repeated use of the unchanged PR2540 added decoder.

```text
112 borrowed X fields: no writes
112 borrowed Y fields: one native/inverse pair per use
N uses, native relative defect u:
  sharp Y restoration drift <= B*((1+u)^(2N)-1)
  sufficient allowance for B*2^-b: u <= 2^-b/(4N)
```

A coherent admissible native bias attains the bound at every positive payload tensor depth. Thus PR2628's sufficient single-call parameter `u=2^(-b-21)` does not imply a uniform unbounded reuse guarantee. This is not a defect in PR2628, which explicitly leaves controller composition open.

Scientific sources are ywz65's PR2540 at `630d557af5088f66b45c447969cee9576600e50b` and PR2628 at `e64a7babb285f22baeee89a9d88f5e79c512909a`. Their exact word/proof bytes and attribution are retained. Credit Ali Romman, thakrarsagar, starship-s and the retained QQ16/native lineage. The newer PR2651 bank-coalescing word is not recertified here.

Started from canonical main `b4560d9e`, priority revision 5, with the drawn `uniform-transfer-audit` card refined to this precision/restoration implication. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2642). Final overlap covered 832 open PRs and 1,297 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; main and both consumed heads were unchanged.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the predecessor provides a single-invocation error contract and already exhibits approximate borrowed restoration, without a reuse-horizon bound.
  **After:** the source audit checks all 2,463 events and 112 inverse pairs. The written proof gives the sharp all-N bound and an admissible counterexample to an unbounded fixed-precision inference.
- Normal and optimized registered replay pass: 11,436 exact field/component checks, seven semantic rejection controls and nine behavioral groups, including source/typed-receipt corruption and Git-free read-only export.
- All 65 research-workflow tests pass. Ruff format/lint and selected-source binding orientation pass on CPython 3.12.15, Linux/WSL2.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/qq16-borrowed-reuse-stability
```

Limitations: this is a declared repeated post-B1 observation boundary, not an existing complete consumer. Actual reuse counts, F0/B1 trajectories, retention errors, output accuracy, physical native implementation, hosting and formal review remain open. No full selected cold replay, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only this opt-in package is added. Selected records, frozen predecessors and production verifiers are unchanged. The replay requires no network, predecessor checkout or third-party dependencies.
